presets.name: Normal Weekday Rush Hour (Baseline)
presets.description: Unconstrained baseline network conditions during morning peak demand with all corridors operating at design capacity.

presets.name: Northern Primary Bridge Closure (Structural Failure)
presets.description: Complete physical closure of Bridge A (Bridge_A_B) due to structural inspection during morning peak hour. Forces 1,800 veh/hr of residential traffic onto southern residential collectors.

disruptions.description: Total vehicular shutdown of Northern Primary Bridge

presets.name: Severe Monsoon Waterlogging & Canal Overflow
presets.description: Intense torrential rainfall causes 50% capacity loss on the primary arterial bridge and 60% capacity loss on the Domlur Canal bottleneck due to severe urban waterlogging.

disruptions.description: Submerged outer lanes on primary bridge
Severe storm drain overflow on Domlur Canal Road

presets.name: Emergency Metro / Road Construction
presets.description: Lane closures for emergency utility repair cut nominal capacity by 50% along the Old Airport Road arterial corridor.

disruptions.description: 2 of 4 lanes barricaded for pipeline maintenance

presets.name: Commercial Tech Summit Demand Surge
presets.description: Major international technology summit in Koramangala causes a 30% surge in inbound commuter demand combined with localized collector bottleneck restrictions.

disruptions.description: Event drop-off congestion reduces collector capacity by 25%
